dimensions.assessment: Affects nonprofit child care providers meeting specific criteria across the nation.
dimensions.evidence: covered nonprofit child care provider means an organization

dimensions.assessment: Grants eligibility for specific loan programs, which can be life-changing for individual providers seeking up to or over $500,000.
dimensions.evidence: a covered nonprofit child care provider shall be deemed to be a small business concern for purposes of loans and financings under section 7(a).

dimensions.assessment: No explicit overall aggregate spending sum is provided, but loan guarantees and financings up to and exceeding $500,000 are authorized.
dimensions.evidence: eligible for such loan or financing of more than $500,000

dimensions.assessment: Amends sections of the Small Business Act and Small Business Investment Act of 1958.
dimensions.evidence: Section 3(a) of the Small Business Act (15 U.S.C. 632(a)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory changes combined with annual reporting requirements.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act, and annually thereafter

missing_information: Total number of eligible nonprofit child care providers nationwide
Total expected federal fiscal outlay or loan volume
importance_detail.rationale: The bill allows nonprofit child care providers to participate in certain Small Business Administration loan programs, altering eligibility and reporting standards without specifying exact funding sums or population totals.
